questions.q: Which of Mendel's laws is universally accepted without any exceptions?
questions.qPa: ਮੈਂਡਲ ਦੇ ਕਿਹੜੇ ਨਿਯਮ ਨੂੰ ਬਿਨਾਂ ਕਿਸੇ ਅਪਵਾਦ (exception) ਦੇ ਵਿਆਪਕ ਤੌਰ 'ਤੇ ਸਵੀਕਾਰ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ?
questions.explanation: The Law of Segregation states that alleles for a trait separate when gametes are formed. This occurs during meiosis and is universally true for all sexually reproducing organisms.

questions.q: What is the phenotypic ratio of a dihybrid test cross (e.g., RrYy x rryy)?
questions.explanation: A test cross involves crossing with a homozygous recessive organism. A dihybrid test cross always yields a 1:1:1:1 ratio for the four possible phenotypes.

questions.q: In snapdragon flowers, crossing a red flower (RR) with a white flower (rr) produces pink flowers (Rr). What will be the phenotypic ratio in the F2 generation if two pink flowers are crossed?
questions.explanation: In incomplete dominance, the F2 generation (Rr x Rr) yields 1 RR (Red), 2 Rr (Pink), and 1 rr (White). So the ratio is 1:2:1.

questions.q: A child has blood group O. If the father has blood group A and mother has blood group B, what must be the genotypes of the parents?
questions.explanation: To have a child with blood group O (genotype ii), the child must receive an 'i' allele from BOTH parents. Therefore, both the A and B parents must be heterozygous carriers of the 'i' allele (I^Ai and I^Bi).
